promptEs: ¿Qué intervalo hay entre Si4 y Fa5?
promptEn: What interval is there between B4 and F5?
explanationEs: De Si a Fa hay cuatro letras y seis semitonos: una quinta disminuida. Es disminuida porque la quinta justa tiene siete semitonos y falta uno.
explanationEn: From B to F there are four letters and six semitones: a diminished fifth. It is diminished because the perfect fifth has seven semitones and one is missing.
